Acknowledgement.description: An acknowledgement is the instructions for the acknowledgement of the order.

acknowledge.description: The value is `true` when each addressee acknowledges the order.

instructions.description: This field gives the instructions for the acknowledgement, as free text.

Acknowledgement.title: Acknowledgement

AdjacentUnit.description: An adjacent unit is one adjacent unit and its mission.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that controls the adjacent unit.

boundary.description: This field identifies the control measure that is the boundary with the adjacent unit.

direction.description: This field gives the direction from this unit to the adjacent unit, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this adjacent unit. Each adjacent unit in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this adjacent unit.

mission.description: This field gives the mission of the adjacent unit, as free text.

name.description: This field gives the name of this adjacent unit, for display.

AdjacentUnit.title: AdjacentUnit

Agreement.description: An agreement is one agreement with the host nation.

effective.description: This field gives the time interval during which the agreement is in effect.

id.description: This field identifies this agreement. Each agreement in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this agreement.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the agreement, as one of the enumerated values.

name.description: This field gives the name of this agreement, for display.

parties.description: This list contains the organizations that sign the agreement.

Agreement.title: Agreement

AirDefenseAppendix.description: An appendix for air and missile defence is `Appendix 7 (Air and Missile Defense)` of Annex D. FM 6-0 (2022) puts these data in Annex D. FM 5-0 (2024) puts them in a different annex, Annex I, which openAIX does not use.

defended_assets.description: This list contains the defended assets, in order.

engagement_authorities.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that have engagement authority.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that are air defence measures.

warnings.description: This list contains the air defence warnings.

weapons_control.description: This list contains the weapons control orders.

AirDefenseAppendix.title: AirDefenseAppendix

AirDefenseWarning.description: An air defence warning is one air defence warning for an area and a time interval.

level.description: This field gives the air defence warning, as one of the enumerated values.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the air defence warning.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the air defence warning is in effect.

AirDefenseWarning.title: AirDefenseWarning

AirSupportAppendix.description: An air support appendix is `Appendix 5 (Air Support)` of Annex D.

agencies.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that control air support.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that give air interdiction and air reconnaissance. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

cas_allocations.description: This list contains the close air support (CAS) allocations.

cas_briefs.description: This list contains the close air support (CAS) briefs that the staff writes before the mission. Each brief has the 9-line data of JP 3-09.3.

points.description: This list identifies the points that are contact points, initial points and holding points for air support. Each point shall have the role `control` or `initial` or `marshalling`.

AirSupportAppendix.title: AirSupportAppendix

AirspaceAppendix.description: An airspace appendix is `Appendix 10 (Airspace)` of Annex C.

agencies.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that control parts of the airspace.

airspace_control_agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that controls the airspace.

coordinating_altitude.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the coordinating altitude.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that are airspace coordinating measures.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the airspace plan, as free text.

AirspaceAppendix.title: AirspaceAppendix

Annexes.description: Annexes are the annexes of the order, by letter. The order shall not have an annex with the letter I, O, T, X or Y.

A.description: This field gives the annex for task organization.

B.description: This field gives the annex for intelligence.

C.description: This field gives the annex for operations.

D.description: This field gives the annex for fires.

E.description: This field gives the annex for protection.

F.description: This field gives the annex for sustainment.

G.description: This field gives the annex for engineer.

H.description: This field gives the annex for signal.

J.description: This field gives the annex for public affairs.

K.description: This field gives the annex for civil affairs operations.

L.description: This field gives the annex for information collection.

M.description: This field gives the annex for assessment.

N.description: This field gives the annex for space operations.

P.description: This field gives the annex for host-nation support.

Q.description: This field gives the annex for knowledge management.

R.description: This field gives the annex for reports.

S.description: This field gives the annex for special technical operations.

U.description: This field gives the annex for inspector general.

V.description: This field gives the annex for interagency coordination.

W.description: This field gives the annex for operational contract support.

Z.description: This field gives the annex for distribution.

Annexes.title: Annexes

AreaOfInterest.description: An area of interest is the area of interest of the operation, as control measures.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that give the area of interest.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the area of interest, as free text.

AreaOfInterest.title: AreaOfInterest

AreaOfOperations.description: An area of operations is the area of operations of the unit, with its terrain and weather.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that give the area of operations and its boundaries.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the area of operations, as free text.

terrain.description: This field gives the terrain data of the area of operations.

weather.description: This field gives the weather data of the area of operations.

AreaOfOperations.title: AreaOfOperations

AssessmentAnnex.description: An annex for assessment is the annex with the letter `M` in the order.

measures_of_effectiveness.description: This list contains the measure of effectiveness (MOE) entries.

measures_of_performance.description: This list contains the measure of performance (MOP) entries.

reframing_criteria.description: This list contains the conditions that cause the staff to change the plan.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex M, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex M, as free text.

AssessmentAnnex.title: AssessmentAnnex

AssistancePoint.description: An inspector general office is one office where personnel can speak to the inspector general.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that the office refers to.

id.description: This field identifies this point. Each point in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this point.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the office, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the office.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the office is open.

AssistancePoint.title: AssistancePoint

Assumption.description: An assumption is one assumption of the plan.

assumption.description: This field gives the assumption, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this assumption. Each assumption in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this assumption.

Assumption.title: Assumption

AttachmentDetachment.description: An attachment or detachment is one change of the headquarters of a unit.

action.description: This field gives the type of the change, attachment or detachment, as one of the enumerated values.

effective.description: This field gives the time of the change.

headquarters.description: This field gives the name of the headquarters that receives or releases the unit, as free text.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the change occurs in.

relationship.description: This field gives the command or support relationship after the change, as one of the enumerated values.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that goes to a different headquarters.

AttachmentDetachment.title: AttachmentDetachment

Authentication.description: An authentication is the signature block of the order.

authenticator_name.description: This field gives the name of the staff officer who authenticates the order, as free text.

authenticator_position.description: This field gives the position of the staff officer who authenticates the order, as free text.

commander_name.description: This field gives the last name of the commander, as free text.

commander_rank.description: This field gives the rank of the commander, as free text.

Authentication.title: Authentication

AvenueOfApproach.description: An avenue of approach is one avenue of approach for a force of one echelon.

direction.description: This field gives the direction of movement on the avenue of approach, as one of the enumerated values.

echelon.description: This field gives the largest echelon that the avenue of approach can hold, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this avenue of approach. Each avenue of approach in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this avenue of approach.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that give the path of the avenue of approach.

name.description: This field gives the name of this avenue of approach, for display.

AvenueOfApproach.title: AvenueOfApproach

BattleRhythmEvent.description: A battle rhythm event is one meeting, board, report or update in the battle rhythm.

attendees.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that are at the event.

chair.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that controls the event.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that the event refers to.

duration_minutes.description: This field gives the length of the event, in minutes.

id.description: This field identifies this event. Each event in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this event.

interval_minutes.description: This field gives the time between two events, in minutes.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the event, as one of the enumerated values.

name.description: This field gives the name of this event, for display.

start.description: This field gives the time of the first event.

BattleRhythmEvent.title: BattleRhythmEvent

CCIR.description: Commander's critical information requirements are the priority intelligence requirement (PIR) and friendly force information requirement (FFIR) lists.

friendly_force_information_requirements.description: This list contains the friendly force information requirement (FFIR) entries, in order.

priority_intelligence_requirements.description: This list contains the priority intelligence requirement (PIR) entries, in order.

CCIR.title: CCIR

CallSign.description: A call sign is one call sign of a unit or an agency for a time interval.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that uses the call sign.

callsign.description: This field gives the call sign, as free text.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that uses the call sign.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the call sign is in effect.

CallSign.title: CallSign

CasAllocation.description: A close air support (CAS) allocation is the CAS for one supported unit.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that give the close air support (CAS). The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the allocation is applicable to.

sorties.description: This field gives the number of close air support (CAS) sorties.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the close air support (CAS).

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the close air support (CAS) is available.

CasAllocation.title: CasAllocation

CivilAffairsAnnex.description: Annex for civil affairs operations are the annex with the letter `K` in the order.

centres.description: This list contains the civil-military operations centres.

dislocated_civilian_routes.description: This list identifies the routes of the resource catalogue for dislocated civilians.

protected_sites.description: This list contains the protected sites.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex K, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex K, as free text.

tasks.description: This list contains the tasks of the execution matrix.

CivilAffairsAnnex.title: CivilAffairsAnnex

CivilConsideration.description: An entry of the civil considerations is one entry of the civil considerations, with its areas, structures, capabilities, organizations, people and events (ASCOPE) class.

category.description: This field gives the areas, structures, capabilities, organizations, people and events (ASCOPE) class of the entry, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this entry. Each entry in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this entry.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the entry.

name.description: This field gives the name of this entry, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the entry, as latitude and longitude.

significance.description: This field gives the effect of the entry on the operation, as free text.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the event occurs.

CivilConsideration.title: CivilConsideration

CivilConsiderations.description: Civil considerations are the very important parts of the situation of the population.

entries.description: This list contains the civil considerations.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the situation of the population, as free text.

CivilConsiderations.title: CivilConsiderations

CivilMilitaryCentre.description: A civil-military operations centre is one centre for coordination with organizations of the population.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that the centre refers to.

id.description: This field identifies this centre. Each centre in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this centre.

name.description: This field gives the name of this centre, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the centre, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the centre.

CivilMilitaryCentre.title: CivilMilitaryCentre

CloudLayer.description: A cloud layer is one layer of cloud, with its coverage, its base and its tops.

base.description: This field gives the base of the layer, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

coverage.description: This field gives the part of the sky that the layer covers, as one of the enumerated values.

tops.description: This field gives the tops of the layer, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

CloudLayer.title: CloudLayer

CollectionTask.description: A collection task is one row of the information collection plan.

ato_mission.description: This field identifies the mission of the air tasking order (ATO) that does the task. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

id.description: This field identifies this task. Each task in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this task.

indicator.description: This field gives the indicator that the task looks for, as free text.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that is the named area of interest of the task.

report.description: This field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that gives the results of the task.

report_to.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that receives the reports.

requirement.description: This field identifies the information requirement that the task gives data for.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that does the task.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the task is in effect.

CollectionTask.title: CollectionTask

Command.description: Command is the location of the leaders and the succession of command.

leaders.description: This list contains the locations of the commander and key leaders.

liaison.description: This list contains the liaison requirements.

succession.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization. The list gives the succession of command, in order.

Command.title: Command

CommandAndSignal.description: Command and signal is paragraph 5 of the order.

command.description: This field gives the command data.

command_posts.description: This list contains the command posts.

signal.description: This field gives the signal data.

CommandAndSignal.title: CommandAndSignal

CommandPost.description: A command post is one command post, its location and the time when it operates.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that the command post operates as.

controls.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the command post controls.

id.description: This field identifies this command post. Each command post in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this command post.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the command post, as one of the enumerated values.

name.description: This field gives the name of this command post, for display.

operational.description: This field gives the time interval during which the command post operates.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the command post, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that the command post is for.

CommandPost.title: CommandPost

CommandRelationship.description: A command relationship is the command or support relationship of one unit.

effective.description: This field gives the time of the start of the entry.

headquarters.description: This field gives the name of the other headquarters of the entry, when it is not in the task organization, as free text.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the entry is applicable to.

relationship.description: This field gives the command relationship or support relationship, as one of the enumerated values.

to.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the other unit of the entry.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that the entry is for.

CommandRelationship.title: CommandRelationship

CommandersIntent.description: A commander's intent is the purpose, key tasks and end state of the operation.

end_state.description: This field gives the end state.

key_tasks.description: This list contains the key tasks.

purpose.description: This field gives the expanded purpose of the operation, as free text.

CommandersIntent.title: CommandersIntent

ConceptOfOperations.description: A concept of operations is the sequence of tasks of the force, with its main effort, areas and phases.

close_area.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the close area.

deep_area.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the deep area.

main_effort.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the main effort.

phases.description: This list contains the phases of the operation, in order.

rear_area.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the rear area.

reserve.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the reserve.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the concept of operations, as free text.

supporting_efforts.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that are supporting efforts of the operation.

ConceptOfOperations.title: ConceptOfOperations

ContractRequirement.description: A contract support requirement is one requirement that contractors support.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield that the support is at.

category.description: This field gives the type of contract support, as one of the enumerated values.

contractor.description: This field gives the name of the contractor, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this requirement. Each requirement in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this requirement.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the support, as latitude and longitude.

requirement.description: This field gives the requirement, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that receive the support.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the contract is in effect.

ContractRequirement.title: ContractRequirement

ContractingOffice.description: A contracting office is one office that makes and controls contracts.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that the office refers to.

id.description: This field identifies this office. Each office in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this office.

name.description: This field gives the name of this office, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the office, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the office.

ContractingOffice.title: ContractingOffice

CoordinatingInstructions.description: Coordinating instructions are the instructions and tasks that are applicable to two or more units.

airspace_coordinating_measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that are airspace coordinating measures that two or more units use.

ccir.description: This field gives the commander's critical information requirement (CCIR).

eefi.description: This list contains the essential elements of friendly information.

effective_condition.description: This field gives the condition that starts the effect of the order, when there is no time, as free text.

effective_time.description: This field gives the time of the start of the effect of the order.

fire_support_coordination_measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that are fire support coordination measure (FSCM) entries that two or more units use.

other.description: This list contains the other coordinating instructions.

personnel_recovery.description: This field gives the measures for personnel recovery.

risk_reduction.description: This field gives the risk reduction measures.

rules_of_engagement.description: This list contains the rules of engagement (ROE).

themes_and_messages.description: This list contains the themes and messages.

timeline.description: This list contains the very important times and events, in order.

CoordinatingInstructions.title: CoordinatingInstructions

DecisionPoint.description: A decision point is one possible decision of the commander, with its time, area and information.

decision.description: This field gives the decision, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this decision point. Each decision point in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this decision point.

latest_time.description: This field gives the time of the last time at which the commander makes the decision.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the decision refers to, such as named areas of interest.

name.description: This field gives the name of this decision point, for display.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the decision is in.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the decision point, as latitude and longitude.

requirements.description: This list identifies the information requirements that support the decision.

trigger.description: This field gives the event or condition that starts the decision, as free text.

DecisionPoint.title: DecisionPoint

DefendedAsset.description: A defended asset is one asset that air defence gives protection to, with its priority.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield that is the asset.

id.description: This field identifies this asset. Each asset in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this asset.

name.description: This field gives the name of this asset, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the asset, as latitude and longitude.

priority.description: This field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the asset.

DefendedAsset.title: DefendedAsset

DistributionAnnex.description: An annex for distribution is the annex with the letter `Z` in the order.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex Z, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex Z, as free text.

DistributionAnnex.title: DistributionAnnex

EEFI.description: An essential element of friendly information is one item of friendly information that the operation keeps from the enemy.

id.description: This field identifies this item. Each item in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this item.

item.description: This field gives the item of friendly information, as free text.

EEFI.title: EEFI

EffectivenessMeasure.description: A measure of effectiveness is one measure of effectiveness (MOE), with its indicators.

id.description: This field identifies this measure. Each measure in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this measure.

statement.description: This field gives the measure, as free text.

EffectivenessMeasure.title: EffectivenessMeasure

ElectromagneticAppendix.description: Appendix for cyberspace electromagnetic activities are `Appendix 12` of Annex C.

emission_control.description: This list contains the emission control periods, in order.

jamming.description: This list contains the jamming coordination entries.

jamming_authority.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that gives approval for electromagnetic attack.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the cyberspace electromagnetic activities, as free text.

ElectromagneticAppendix.title: ElectromagneticAppendix

EmissionControlPeriod.description: An emission control period is one emission control level for a time interval.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that the level is applicable to. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

id.description: This field identifies this period. Each period in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this period.

level.description: This field gives the emission control level, as one of the enumerated values.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that give the area of the level.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that the level is applicable to.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the level is in effect.

EmissionControlPeriod.title: EmissionControlPeriod

EndState.description: An end state is the conditions that the operation sets at its end.

conditions.description: This list contains the conditions of the end state.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the end state, as free text.

EndState.title: EndState

EndStateCondition.description: An end state condition is one condition of the end state.

condition.description: This field gives the condition, as free text.

domain.description: This field gives the part of the situation that the condition refers to, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this condition. Each condition in the end state has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this condition.

EndStateCondition.title: EndStateCondition

EnemyCourseOfAction.description: An enemy course of action is one course of action (COA) that the enemy can use.

id.description: This field identifies this enemy course of action (COA). Each enemy COA in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this enemy COA.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the enemy course of action (COA), as one of the enumerated values.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the enemy course of action (COA) refers to.

name.description: This field gives the name of this enemy course of action (COA), for display.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the enemy course of action (COA), as free text.

EnemyCourseOfAction.title: EnemyCourseOfAction

EnemyForces.description: Enemy forces are the enemy units and the courses of action that they can use.

courses_of_action.description: This list contains the courses of action that the enemy can use.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the enemy forces and their capabilities, as free text.

units.description: This list contains the enemy units.

EnemyForces.title: EnemyForces

EnemyUnit.description: An enemy unit is one enemy unit, with its composition, disposition and strength.

as_of.description: This field gives the time of the data about the enemy unit.

echelon.description: This field gives the echelon of the enemy unit, as one of the enumerated values.

emitters.description: This list identifies the emitters of the resource catalogue that this enemy unit operates.

id.description: This field identifies this enemy unit. Each enemy unit in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this enemy unit.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the enemy unit.

name.description: This field gives the name of this enemy unit, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the enemy unit, as latitude and longitude.

strength_percent.description: This field gives the strength of the enemy unit, in percent of its full strength.

targets.description: This list identifies the targets of the resource catalogue that are parts of this enemy unit.

threats.description: This list identifies the threats of the resource catalogue that this enemy unit has.

unit_type.description: This field gives the type of the enemy unit, as free text.

EnemyUnit.title: EnemyUnit

EngineerAnnex.description: An annex for engineer is the annex with the letter `G` in the order.

obstacle_zones.description: This list identifies the control measures that are obstacle control areas.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex G, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex G, as free text.

survivability_priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of survivability work.

EngineerAnnex.title: EngineerAnnex

ExchangePoint.description: An ambulance exchange point is one point where casualties change from one ambulance to a different ambulance.

id.description: This field identifies this ambulance exchange point. Each ambulance exchange point in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this ambulance exchange point.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the ambulance exchange point.

name.description: This field gives the name of this ambulance exchange point, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the ambulance exchange point, as latitude and longitude.

ExchangePoint.title: ExchangePoint

Execution.description: Execution is paragraph 3 of the order.

commanders_intent.description: This field gives the intent of the commander.

concept_of_operations.description: This field gives the concept of operations.

coordinating_instructions.description: This field gives the coordinating instructions.

schemes.description: This field gives the schemes of support.

tasks_to_subordinate_units.description: This list contains the tasks to subordinate units, in order. The units are in the sequence of the task organization.

Execution.title: Execution

FieldArtilleryAppendix.description: A field artillery appendix is `Appendix 4 (Field Artillery Support)` of Annex D.

position_areas.description: This list identifies the control measures that are position areas of the field artillery.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of field artillery fires.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that give field artillery support.

FieldArtilleryAppendix.title: FieldArtilleryAppendix

FinancialManagement.description: A financial management is the plan for the funds of the order.

programs.description: This list contains the programs of funds.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the financial management support, as free text.

FinancialManagement.title: FinancialManagement

FiresAnnex.description: Annex for fires are the annex with the letter `D` in the order. Each reference in `fire_support_coordination_measures` shall identify a measure of the fire support coordination measure (FSCM) class.

air_and_missile_defense.description: This field gives `Appendix 7 (Air and Missile Defense)`.

fire_support_coordination_measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that are fire support coordination measure (FSCM) entries.

priority_of_fires.description: This list contains the priorities of fires.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex D, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex D, as free text.

FiresAnnex.title: FiresAnnex

FriendlyForces.description: Friendly forces are the higher headquarters, the adjacent units and the agencies that support the unit.

adjacent_units.description: This list contains the adjacent units.

higher_one_level.description: This field gives the headquarters one level above the unit.

higher_two_levels.description: This field gives the headquarters two levels above the unit.

supporting_agencies.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that support the operation.

FriendlyForces.title: FriendlyForces

FundingProgram.description: A program of funds is one source of funds for the operation.

id.description: This field identifies this program. Each program in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this program.

limit.description: This field gives the maximum value of the program.

name.description: This field gives the name of this program, for display.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that controls the funds.

FundingProgram.title: FundingProgram

HealthServiceSupport.description: A health service support is the medical support plan of the order.

evacuation.description: This field gives the medical evacuation plan.

facilities.description: This list contains the medical treatment facilities.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the health service support, as free text.

HealthServiceSupport.title: HealthServiceSupport

HighPayoffTarget.description: A high-payoff target is one entry of the attack guidance: the target, the time and method of attack, and the effect.

assessment_required.description: The value is `true` when units send a battle damage assessment (BDA) report after the attack.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that attack the target. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

effect.description: This field gives the effect on the target, as one of the enumerated values.

emitter.description: This field identifies the emitter of the resource catalogue that this entry is for.

id.description: This field identifies this entry. Each entry in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this entry.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the entry is applicable to.

priority.description: This field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.

target.description: This field identifies the target of the resource catalogue that this entry is for.

threat.description: This field identifies the threat of the resource catalogue that this entry is for.

timing.description: This field gives the time of attack, as one of the enumerated values.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that attack the target.

HighPayoffTarget.title: HighPayoffTarget

HighValueTarget.description: A high-value target is one target that is necessary for the mission of the enemy commander.

function.description: This field gives the enemy function of the target, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this target. Each target in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this target.

name.description: This field gives the name of this target, for display.

target.description: This field identifies the target of the resource catalogue that this entry is for.

threat.description: This field identifies the threat of the resource catalogue that this entry is for.

HighValueTarget.title: HighValueTarget

HigherHeadquarters.description: Higher headquarters are the mission and intent of one higher headquarters.

commanders_intent.description: This field gives the intent of the commander of the higher headquarters, as free text.

concept_of_operations.description: This field gives the concept of operations of the higher headquarters, as free text.

mission.description: This field gives the mission statement of the higher headquarters, as free text.

name.description: This field gives the name of this headquarters, for display.

order.description: This field identifies the order of the higher headquarters.

HigherHeadquarters.title: HigherHeadquarters

HostNationSupport.description: A host-nation support item is one type of support that the host nation gives.

agreement.description: This field gives the identifier of the agreement for the support, from `agreements`.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield that receives the support.

category.description: This field gives the class of the support, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this item. Each item in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this item.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the support, as latitude and longitude.

provider.description: This field gives the name of the provider, as free text.

HostNationSupport.title: HostNationSupport

HostNationSupportAnnex.description: An annex for host-nation support is the annex with the letter `P` in the order.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex P, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex P, as free text.

support.description: This list contains the host-nation support items.

HostNationSupportAnnex.title: HostNationSupportAnnex

Indicator.description: An indicator is one indicator of an assessment measure, with its threshold.

id.description: This field identifies this indicator. Each indicator in its measure has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this indicator.

indicator.description: This field gives the indicator, as free text.

threshold.description: This field gives the value of the indicator that shows that the operation is on plan, as free text.

Indicator.title: Indicator

InformationCollectionAnnex.description: An annex for information collection is the annex with the letter `L` in the order.

collection_tasks.description: This list contains the collection tasks.

handover_lines.description: This list identifies the control measures that are intelligence handover lines.

named_areas_of_interest.description: This list identifies the control measures that give the named areas of interest.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex L, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex L, as free text.

InformationCollectionAnnex.title: InformationCollectionAnnex

InformationRequirement.description: An information requirement is one priority intelligence requirement (PIR) or friendly force information requirement (FFIR) of the commander's critical information requirement (CCIR).

decision_point.description: This field identifies the decision point that the requirement supports.

id.description: This field identifies this requirement. Each requirement in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this requirement.

indicators.description: This list contains the indicators that give data for the requirement.

latest_time.description: This field gives the time of the last time at which the information is of value.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the requirement refers to, such as named areas of interest.

number.description: This field gives the number of the requirement, such as `PIR 1`, as free text.

question.description: This field gives the requirement, as a question, as free text.

report_to.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that receives the reports.

InformationRequirement.title: InformationRequirement

InformationSystem.description: An information system is one information system for command and control.

channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that the system refers to.

id.description: This field identifies this system. Each system in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this system.

name.description: This field gives the name of this system, for display.

purpose.description: This field gives the purpose of the system, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that use the system.

InformationSystem.title: InformationSystem

Inspection.description: An inspection is one inspection of the inspector general.

id.description: This field identifies this inspection. Each inspection in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this inspection.

subject.description: This field gives the procedure, equipment or area of the inspection, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that the inspection is for.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the inspection occurs.

Inspection.title: Inspection

InspectorGeneralAnnex.description: An annex for inspector general is the annex with the letter `U` in the order.

assistance_points.description: This list contains the offices of the inspector general.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex U, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex U, as free text.

InspectorGeneralAnnex.title: InspectorGeneralAnnex

Instruction.description: An instruction is one instruction of the coordinating instructions, with an identifier.

id.description: This field identifies this instruction. Each instruction in its list has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this instruction.

instruction.description: This field gives the instruction, as free text.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the instruction refers to.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that the instruction is for.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the instruction is in effect.

Instruction.title: Instruction

IntelligenceAnnex.description: Annex for intelligence is the annex with the letter `B` in the order.

high_value_targets.description: This list contains the high-value targets.

products.description: This list contains the intelligence products.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex B, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex B, as free text.

threat_assessments.description: This list contains the threat assessments.

IntelligenceAnnex.title: IntelligenceAnnex

IntelligenceProduct.description: An intelligence product is one intelligence product and its distribution.

agencies.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that receive the intelligence product.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that sends the intelligence product.

due.description: This field gives the time of the first issue of the intelligence product.

id.description: This field identifies this intelligence product. Each intelligence product in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this intelligence product.

interval_minutes.description: This field gives the time between two issues of the intelligence product, in minutes.

name.description: This field gives the name of this intelligence product, for display.

recipients.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that receive the intelligence product.

IntelligenceProduct.title: IntelligenceProduct

InteragencyCoordinationAnnex.description: An annex for interagency coordination is the annex with the letter `V` in the order.

legal_considerations.description: This list contains the legal considerations.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex V, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex V, as free text.

tasks.description: This list contains the tasks and milestones with organizations that are not part of the armed forces, in order.

InteragencyCoordinationAnnex.title: InteragencyCoordinationAnnex

InteragencyOrganization.description: An interagency organization is one organization that is not part of the armed forces and that has a part in the operation.

channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that the organization uses for coordination.

id.description: This field identifies this organization. Each organization in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this organization.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the organization, as one of the enumerated values.

liaison.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the liaison to the organization.

name.description: This field gives the name of this organization, for display.

objectives.description: This list contains the objectives of the organization.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the office of the organization, as latitude and longitude.

InteragencyOrganization.title: InteragencyOrganization

InteragencyTask.description: A coordination task is one task or milestone with an organization that is not part of the armed forces.

area.description: This field gives the area of the coordination, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this task. Each task in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this task.

organization.description: This field identifies the interagency organization that the task is with.

task.description: This field gives the task or milestone, as free text.

time.description: This field gives the time of the milestone.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that does the task.

InteragencyTask.title: InteragencyTask

JammingCoordination.description: A jamming coordination is one time interval of electromagnetic attack, with its emitters and the frequencies that it keeps clear.

area.description: This field identifies the area of the resource catalogue that the jamming aircraft operate in.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that do the jamming. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

authority.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that gives approval for the jamming.

emitters.description: This list identifies the emitters of the resource catalogue that are the objects of the jamming.

id.description: This field identifies this entry. Each entry in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this entry.

protected_frequencies.description: This list contains the frequencies that the jamming does not have an effect on.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the jamming occurs.

JammingCoordination.title: JammingCoordination

KeyPeriod.description: A communications security (COMSEC) key period is one period of COMSEC key material.

channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that use the key.

id.description: This field identifies this key period. Each key period in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this key period.

key.description: This field gives the name of the key, as the exercise key list gives it, as free text.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the key is in effect.

KeyPeriod.title: KeyPeriod

KeyTask.description: A key task is one key task of the intent of the commander.

id.description: This field identifies this key task. Each key task in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this key task.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the key task refers to.

task.description: This field gives the key task, as free text.

KeyTask.title: KeyTask

KeyTerrain.description: Key terrain is one area or point of key terrain.

id.description: This field identifies this key terrain. Each key terrain in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this key terrain.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the key terrain.

name.description: This field gives the name of this key terrain, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the key terrain, as latitude and longitude.

significance.description: This field gives the effect of the key terrain on the operation, as free text.

KeyTerrain.title: KeyTerrain

KnowledgeManagementAnnex.description: An annex for knowledge management is the annex with the letter `Q` in the order.

battle_rhythm.description: This list contains the battle rhythm events.

information_systems.description: This list contains the information systems.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex Q, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex Q, as free text.

KnowledgeManagementAnnex.title: KnowledgeManagementAnnex

Lane.description: A lane is one lane through an obstacle.

entry.description: This field gives the geographic position of the entry of the lane, as latitude and longitude.

exit.description: This field gives the geographic position of the exit of the lane, as latitude and longitude.

id.description: This field identifies this lane. Each lane in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this lane.

marking.description: This field gives the marking of the lane, as free text.

name.description: This field gives the name of this lane, for display.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that opens the lane.

width.description: This field gives the width of the lane, as a length with its unit.

Lane.title: Lane

LeaderLocation.description: A leader location is the location of the commander or of one key leader.

command_post.description: This field identifies the command post that the leader is at.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the location is applicable to.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the leader, as latitude and longitude.

role.description: This field gives the role of the leader, such as `commander`, as free text.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that the leader is in.

LeaderLocation.title: LeaderLocation

Liaison.description: A liaison requirement is one liaison element of the operation.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that receives the liaison element.

headquarters.description: This field gives the name of the headquarters that receives the liaison element, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this liaison element. Each liaison element in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this liaison element.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the liaison element, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that sends the liaison element.

Liaison.title: Liaison

LightData.description: Light data is the times of sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset for one day of the operation.

begin_morning_nautical_twilight.description: This field gives the time of the begin morning nautical twilight.

date.description: This field gives the date of the light data, as a `YYYY-MM-DD` date.

end_evening_nautical_twilight.description: This field gives the time of the end evening nautical twilight.

moon_illumination_percent.description: This field gives the illumination of the moon, in percent.

moonrise.description: This field gives the time of moonrise.

moonset.description: This field gives the time of moonset.

sunrise.description: This field gives the time of sunrise.

sunset.description: This field gives the time of sunset.

LightData.title: LightData

Logistics.description: Logistics is the logistics plan of the order.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of logistics support.

routes.description: This list identifies the supply routes of the resource catalogue that the units follow.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the logistics plan, as free text.

supply_points.description: This list contains the supply points.

Logistics.title: Logistics

MedicalEvacuation.description: A medical evacuation is the medical evacuation plan of the order.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that receives medical evacuation requests.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that are medical evacuation aircraft. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

exchange_points.description: This list contains the ambulance exchange points.

request_channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that units send medical evacuation requests on.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the medical evacuation plan, as free text.

MedicalEvacuation.title: MedicalEvacuation

MedicalFacility.description: A medical treatment facility is one medical facility and its role of care.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield that has the facility.

id.description: This field identifies this facility. Each facility in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this facility.

name.description: This field gives the name of this facility, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the facility, as latitude and longitude.

role.description: This field gives the role of care of the facility, from 1 to 4.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the facility.

MedicalFacility.title: MedicalFacility

Message.description: A theme or message is one theme or message that units use or avoid.

audience.description: This field gives the group of persons that receives the message, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this message. Each message in its list has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this message.

kind.description: This field gives the instruction for the message: use the message or avoid it, as one of the enumerated values.

message.description: This field gives the theme or message, as free text.

Message.title: Message

MissionParagraph.description: A mission is paragraph 2 of the order: the units, the task, the time, the area and the purpose.

objectives.description: This list identifies the control measures that are the objectives of the mission.

purpose.description: This field gives the purpose of the mission, as free text.

statement.description: This field gives the mission statement, as free text.

task.description: This field gives the task of the mission, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the mission.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the unit does the mission.

MissionParagraph.title: MissionParagraph

Money.description: A value in a currency is a value with its currency.

amount.description: This field gives the value, in the currency of `currency`.

currency.description: This field gives the currency, as a code of `ISO 4217` such as `USD`.

Money.title: Money

Movement.description: A movement is one movement of a unit on a route.

arrival.description: This field gives the time of arrival at the release point.

departure.description: This field gives the time of departure from the start point.

id.description: This field identifies this movement. Each movement in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this movement.

release_point.description: This field identifies the control measure that is the release point.

route.description: This field identifies the route of the resource catalogue that the unit follows.

start_point.description: This field identifies the control measure that is the start point.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that moves.

Movement.title: Movement

NavalFireAppendix.description: An appendix for naval fire support is `Appendix 6 (Naval Fire Support)` of Annex D.

fire_support_areas.description: This list identifies the control measures that are fire support areas and fire support stations.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that give naval fire support.

NavalFireAppendix.title: NavalFireAppendix

NavigationOutage.description: A navigation outage is one time interval in which satellite navigation has a large position error.

expected_error.description: This field gives the possible position error, as a length with its unit.

id.description: This field identifies this navigation outage. Each navigation outage in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this navigation outage.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the navigation outage.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which satellite navigation has a large position error.

NavigationOutage.title: NavigationOutage

Net.description: A radio net is one radio net, its channels and its members.

agencies.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that are members of the net.

alternate.description: This field identifies the radio channel that is the alternate channel of the net.

control.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that controls the net.

id.description: This field identifies this net. Each net in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this net.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the net, as one of the enumerated values.

members.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that are members of the net.

name.description: This field gives the name of this net, for display.

primary.description: This field identifies the radio channel that is the primary channel of the net.

Net.title: Net

Objective.description: An objective is one objective with an identifier.

id.description: This field identifies this objective. Each objective in its list has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this objective.

objective.description: This field gives the objective, as free text.

Objective.title: Objective

Obstacle.description: An obstacle is one obstacle, with its effect and its unit.

complete_by.description: This field gives the time of the end of the work on the obstacle.

effect.description: This field gives the effect of the obstacle, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this obstacle. Each obstacle in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this obstacle.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the obstacle, as one of the enumerated values.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the obstacle.

name.description: This field gives the name of this obstacle, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the obstacle, as latitude and longitude.

status.description: This field gives the condition of the obstacle, as one of the enumerated values.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that controls the obstacle.

Obstacle.title: Obstacle

OperationalContractSupportAnnex.description: An annex for operational contract support is the annex with the letter `W` in the order.

accountability_report.description: This field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that gives the accountability of contractors.

offices.description: This list contains the contracting offices.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex W, as free text.

requirements.description: This list contains the contract support requirements.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex W, as free text.

OperationalContractSupportAnnex.title: OperationalContractSupportAnnex

OperationsAnnex.description: Annex for operations are the annex with the letter `C` in the order.

decision_points.description: This list contains the decision points of the decision support products.

operation_overlay.description: This list identifies the control measures that are on the operation overlay.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex C, as free text.

rules_of_engagement.description: This list contains the rules of `Appendix 11 (Rules of Engagement)`.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex C, as free text.

OperationsAnnex.title: OperationsAnnex

OrderLinks.description: Order links are the orders that this document uses. Validation finds each mission reference in the air tasking order (ATO) that this field identifies. References to units, phases and protected sites of an operation order (OPORD) use the OPORD that this field identifies.

aco.description: This field identifies the airspace control order (ACO) that this document uses.

ato.description: This field identifies the air tasking order (ATO) that this document uses.

opord.description: This field identifies the operation order (OPORD) that this document uses.

spins.description: This field identifies the special instructions (SPINS) publication that this document uses.

OrderLinks.title: OrderLinks

OrderRef.description: An order reference is the identifier and the revision of one order.

id.description: This field identifies the order that this reference is for. The value is the `meta.id` field of the order.

revision.description: This field gives the revision of the order. The value is the `meta.revision` field of the order.

OrderRef.title: OrderRef

PaceMeans.description: A communication method is one method of a primary, alternate, contingency and emergency (PACE) plan.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that the method refers to.

method.description: This field gives the type of the method, as one of the enumerated values.

PaceMeans.title: PaceMeans

PacePlan.description: A primary, alternate, contingency and emergency (PACE) plan is the methods of communication for one function, in the PACE sequence.

alternate.description: This field gives the alternate method.

contingency.description: This field gives the contingency method.

emergency.description: This field gives the emergency method.

function.description: This field gives the function or net of the plan, such as `command`, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this plan. Each plan in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this plan.

primary.description: This field gives the primary method.

PacePlan.title: PacePlan

PerformanceMeasure.description: A measure of performance is one measure of performance (MOP) for a task.

id.description: This field identifies this measure. Each measure in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this measure.

indicator.description: This field gives the indicator of performance, as free text.

task.description: This field gives the task that the measure is for, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that the measure is applicable to.

PerformanceMeasure.title: PerformanceMeasure

Personnel.description: A personnel support is the personnel support plan of the order.

casualty_report.description: This field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that gives the casualties.

strength_report.description: This field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that gives the personnel strength.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the personnel support, as free text.

Personnel.title: Personnel

PersonnelRecoveryMeasures.description: A measures for personnel recovery is the measures for personnel recovery in the operation.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that controls personnel recovery.

channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that are for isolated personnel and recovery forces.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the recovery refers to, such as safe areas and contact points.

recovery_forces.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that are personnel recovery forces. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the instructions for isolated personnel, as free text.

PersonnelRecoveryMeasures.title: PersonnelRecoveryMeasures

Phase.description: A phase is one phase of the concept of operations.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that are in the phase. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

end.description: This field gives the time of the end of the phase.

end_condition.description: This field gives the condition that completes the phase, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this phase. Each phase in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this phase.

main_effort.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the main effort in the phase.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the phase refers to.

name.description: This field gives the name of this phase, for display.

number.description: This field gives the number of the phase. The order writes the number as a Roman numeral.

start.description: This field gives the time of the start of the phase.

start_condition.description: This field gives the condition that starts the phase, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the phase, as free text.

Phase.title: Phase

PrintExtension.description: A print extension is the page data that `opord-builder` puts on each printed page of the order. The namespace is `org.opord-builder.print`, and the group is for this application only.

classification_banner.description: This field gives the classification marking on the top and the bottom of each page.

classification_caveat.description: This field gives the dissemination caveat after the classification marking, such as `REL TO USA, FVEY`, as free text.

copy_number.description: This field gives the number of this copy in the distribution. The number should not be more than `number_of_copies`.

logo.description: This field gives the path or the web address of the logo for the cover page.

message_reference_number.description: This field gives the message reference number that the originator gives to the order, as free text.

number_of_copies.description: This field gives the number of copies in the distribution.

page_icon.description: This field gives the path or the web address of the icon for the header of each page.

place_of_issue.description: This field gives the place where the order is issued, as free text.

watermark.description: This field gives the watermark of each page: short text such as `DRAFT`, or the path or the web address of an image.

PrintExtension.title: PrintExtension

Priority.description: A priority entry is one entry of a priority list, with a rank and the unit, area, phase or asset that it is for.

asset.description: This field gives the name of the asset that has this priority, when no unit or control measure identifies it, as free text.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that has this priority.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that this priority is applicable to.

rank.description: This field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about this priority, as free text.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that has this priority.

Priority.title: Priority

ProtectedAsset.description: A protection priority is one asset of the list of protection priorities.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield that is the asset.

id.description: This field identifies this asset. Each asset in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this asset.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the asset.

name.description: This field gives the name of this asset, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the asset, as latitude and longitude.

priority.description: This field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the asset.

ProtectedAsset.title: ProtectedAsset

ProtectedSite.description: A protected site is one site that the operation keeps safe from attack.

id.description: This field identifies this site. Each site in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this site.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the site, as one of the enumerated values.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the site.

name.description: This field gives the name of this site, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the site, as latitude and longitude.

restriction.description: This field gives the restriction on attacks against the site, as one of the enumerated values.

ProtectedSite.title: ProtectedSite

ProtectionAnnex.description: An annex for protection is the annex with the letter `E` in the order.

eefi.description: This list contains the essential elements of friendly information for operations security.

mopp_level.description: This field gives the protective posture against chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) hazards, as one of the enumerated values.

protection_priorities.description: This list contains the protection priorities, in order.

reaction_forces.description: This list contains the reaction forces.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex E, as free text.

risk_controls.description: This list contains the risk controls.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex E, as free text.

ProtectionAnnex.title: ProtectionAnnex

PublicAffairsAnnex.description: Annex for public affairs are the annex with the letter `J` in the order.

ground_rules.description: This list contains the media ground rules.

messages.description: This list contains the themes and messages.

objectives.description: This list contains the public affairs objectives.

release_authorities.description: This list contains the release authorities.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex J, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex J, as free text.

PublicAffairsAnnex.title: PublicAffairsAnnex

ReactionForce.description: A reaction force is one reaction force with its area and its time of movement.

area.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the reaction force.

response_minutes.description: This field gives the time from the alert to the movement of the reaction force, in minutes.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the reaction force.

ReactionForce.title: ReactionForce

Recipient.description: A recipient is one addressee of the order.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that receives the order.

copies.description: This field gives the number of copies.

name.description: This field gives the name of this recipient, when no unit or agency identifies it, for display.

purpose.description: This field gives the purpose of the copy, as one of the enumerated values.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the order.

Recipient.title: Recipient

RecoveryAppendix.description: An appendix for personnel recovery is `Appendix 16 (Personnel Recovery)` of Annex C.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that coordinates personnel recovery.

channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that are for isolated personnel and recovery forces.

contact_points.description: This list identifies the points that are contact points for recovery forces. Each point shall have the role `control`.

recovery_forces.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that are recovery forces. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

safe_areas.description: This list identifies the control measures that are safe areas for isolated personnel.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the personnel recovery plan, as free text.

RecoveryAppendix.title: RecoveryAppendix

ReleaseAuthority.description: A release authority is the authority that releases information of one type.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that releases the information.

topic.description: This field gives the type of information, as free text.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that releases the information.

ReleaseAuthority.title: ReleaseAuthority

ReportRequirement.description: A report requirement is one report that units send, with its time and recipient.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that send the report. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that sends the report.

due.description: This field gives the time of the first report.

from_units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that send the report.

interval_minutes.description: This field gives the time between two reports, in minutes.

report.description: This field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that this requirement is for.

to_agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that receives the report.

to_unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the report.

trigger.description: This field gives the event that causes the report, as free text.

ReportRequirement.title: ReportRequirement

ReportsAnnex.description: Annex for reports are the annex with the letter `R` in the order.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex R, as free text.

reports.description: This list contains the report requirements.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex R, as free text.

ReportsAnnex.title: ReportsAnnex

RestrictedFrequency.description: A restricted frequency is one entry of the restricted frequency list.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that controls the frequency.

channel.description: This field identifies the radio channel that the restriction is for.

frequency.description: This field gives the frequency of the restriction, when no channel identifies it, as a frequency with its unit.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the restriction, as one of the enumerated values.

RestrictedFrequency.title: RestrictedFrequency

RetransmissionSite.description: A retransmission site is one site that sends radio signals again to extend the range.
