channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that the retransmission site sends again.

id.description: This field identifies this site. Each site in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this site.

name.description: This field gives the name of this site, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the site, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the site.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the site operates.

RetransmissionSite.title: RetransmissionSite

RiskControl.description: Risk control is one hazard and its control.

control.description: This field gives the control of the hazard, as free text.

hazard.description: This field gives the hazard, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this control. Each control in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this control.

initial_risk.description: This field gives the risk level before the control, as one of the enumerated values.

residual_risk.description: This field gives the risk level after the control, as one of the enumerated values.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that apply the control.

RiskControl.title: RiskControl

RiskReduction.description: Risk reduction measures are the risk controls of the operation that the unit procedures do not include.

emission_control.description: This field gives the emission control level, as one of the enumerated values.

fratricide_measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that prevent fratricide.

instructions.description: This list contains the other risk controls.

mopp_level.description: This field gives the protective posture against chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) hazards, as one of the enumerated values.

RiskReduction.title: RiskReduction

RoeRule.description: A rule of engagement is one rule of the rules of engagement (ROE), with its number and its control measures.

id.description: This field identifies this rule. Each rule in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this rule.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the rule is applicable to.

number.description: This field gives the number of the rule in the rules of engagement (ROE), such as `R-101`, as free text.

rule.description: This field gives the rule, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that the rule is applicable to.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the rule is in effect.

RoeRule.title: RoeRule

SchemeOfAirAndMissileDefense.description: A scheme of air and missile defence is the part of the concept of operations that gives the priorities, allocation and restrictions of air defence.

air_defense_warning.description: This field gives the air defence warning at the start of the operation, as one of the enumerated values.

engagement_authority.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that has the engagement authority.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of air and missile defence refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of air and missile defence gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of air and missile defence.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of air and missile defence, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of air and missile defence.

weapons_control_status.description: This field gives the weapons control status at the start of the operation, as one of the enumerated values.

SchemeOfAirAndMissileDefense.title: SchemeOfAirAndMissileDefense

SchemeOfAirspaceControl.description: A scheme of airspace control is the part of the concept of operations that gives the control of the airspace above the area of operations.

agencies.description: This list identifies the command and control agencies that control the airspace.

coordinating_altitude.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the coordinating altitude.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of airspace control refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of airspace control gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of airspace control.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of airspace control, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of airspace control.

SchemeOfAirspaceControl.title: SchemeOfAirspaceControl

SchemeOfEngineering.description: A scheme of engineering is the part of the concept of operations that gives the mobility, countermobility, survivability, general and geospatial engineering tasks.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of engineering refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of engineering gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of engineering.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of engineering, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of engineering.

SchemeOfEngineering.title: SchemeOfEngineering

SchemeOfFires.description: A scheme of fires is the part of the concept of operations that gives the priorities, allocation and restrictions of fires.

air_support.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that give air support. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of fires refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of fires gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of fires.

restrictions.description: This list contains the restrictions on fires.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of fires, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of fires.

SchemeOfFires.title: SchemeOfFires

SchemeOfInformationCollection.description: A scheme of information collection is the part of the concept of operations that gives the reconnaissance and surveillance tasks.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that do reconnaissance or surveillance. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of information collection refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of information collection gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of information collection.

reconnaissance_objectives.description: This list identifies the control measures that are the primary reconnaissance objectives.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of information collection, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of information collection.

SchemeOfInformationCollection.title: SchemeOfInformationCollection

SchemeOfIntelligence.description: A scheme of intelligence is the part of the concept of operations that gives the intelligence support to the operation.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of intelligence refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of intelligence gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of intelligence.

priority_of_effort.description: This list contains the intelligence tasks, in the sequence of priority, in order.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of intelligence, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of intelligence.

SchemeOfIntelligence.title: SchemeOfIntelligence

SchemeOfManeuver.description: A scheme of manoeuvre is the part of the concept of operations that gives the employment of the manoeuvre units.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of manoeuvre refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of manoeuvre gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of manoeuvre.

reserve.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the reserve.

reserve_priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the reserve.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of manoeuvre, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of manoeuvre.

SchemeOfManeuver.title: SchemeOfManeuver

SchemeOfProtection.description: A scheme of protection is the part of the concept of operations that gives the priorities of protection by unit and area.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the scheme of protection refers to.

phases.description: This list identifies the phases of the operation that the scheme of protection gives data for.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of the scheme of protection.

reaction_forces.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that are reaction forces.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of protection, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that do the scheme of protection.

SchemeOfProtection.title: SchemeOfProtection

Schemes.description: Schemes are the schemes of support that the concept of operations contains.

air_and_missile_defense.description: This field gives the scheme of air and missile defence.

airspace_control.description: This field gives the scheme of airspace control.

engineering.description: This field gives the scheme of engineering.

fires.description: This field gives the scheme of fires.

information_collection.description: This field gives the scheme of information collection.

intelligence.description: This field gives the scheme of intelligence.

maneuver.description: This field gives the scheme of manoeuvre.

protection.description: This field gives the scheme of protection.

Schemes.title: Schemes

Signal.description: Signal is the concept of signal support.

channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that the order refers to.

pace_plans.description: This list contains the primary, alternate, contingency and emergency (PACE) plans.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the concept of signal support, as free text.

Signal.title: Signal

SignalAnnex.description: Annex for signal is the annex with the letter `H` in the order.

call_signs.description: This list contains the call signs.

comsec.description: This list contains the communications security (COMSEC) key periods, in order.

nets.description: This list contains the radio nets.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex H, as free text.

restricted_frequencies.description: This list contains the restricted frequencies.

retransmission_sites.description: This list contains the retransmission sites.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex H, as free text.

SignalAnnex.title: SignalAnnex

Situation.description: Situation is paragraph 1 of the order.

area_of_interest.description: This field gives the area of interest.

area_of_operations.description: This field gives the area of operations, with its terrain and weather.

assumptions.description: This list contains the assumptions of the plan.

attachments_and_detachments.description: This list contains the attachments and detachments.

civil_considerations.description: This field gives the civil considerations.

enemy_forces.description: This field gives the enemy forces.

friendly_forces.description: This field gives the friendly forces.

interagency_organizations.description: This list contains the organizations that are not part of the armed forces.

Situation.title: Situation

SpaceCapability.description: A space capability is one space capability that the operation uses.

id.description: This field identifies this capability. Each capability in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this capability.

mission_area.description: This field gives the space mission area, as one of the enumerated values.

provider.description: This field gives the name of the provider of the capability, as free text.

units.description: This list identifies the units of the task organization that use the capability.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the capability is available.

SpaceCapability.title: SpaceCapability

SpaceOperationsAnnex.description: Annex for space operations are the annex with the letter `N` in the order.

capabilities.description: This list contains the space capabilities.

navigation_outages.description: This list contains the navigation outages.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex N, as free text.

satellite_channels.description: This list identifies the radio channels that are satellite channels.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex N, as free text.

SpaceOperationsAnnex.title: SpaceOperationsAnnex

SpecialTechnicalOperationsAnnex.description: Annex for special technical operations are the annex with the letter `S` in the order. An openAIX document contains only unclassified data.

capabilities.description: This list contains the unclassified entries of the capabilities integration matrix.

classified_annex.description: This field identifies the classified annex that contains the full data.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex S, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex S, as free text.

SpecialTechnicalOperationsAnnex.title: SpecialTechnicalOperationsAnnex

StoCapability.description: Entry for special technical operations are one unclassified entry of the capabilities integration matrix.

coordinator.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that coordinates the entry.

functional_area.description: This field gives the functional area, as one of the enumerated values.

id.description: This field identifies this entry. Each entry in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this entry.

name.description: This field gives the name of this entry, for display.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the entry is applicable to.

StoCapability.title: StoCapability

SupplyAllocation.description: A supply allocation is one allocation of a class of supply to a unit.

item.description: This field gives the item of supply, such as `JP-8` or `GBU-12`, as free text.

quantity.description: This field gives the quantity, in the unit of `unit_of_measure`.

supply_class.description: This field gives the class of supply, as one of the enumerated values.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the allocation.

unit_of_measure.description: This field gives the unit of the quantity, as one of the enumerated values.

SupplyAllocation.title: SupplyAllocation

SupplyPoint.description: A supply point is one point where units get supplies or services.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield that has the supply point.

classes.description: This list contains the classes of supply at the point.

id.description: This field identifies this supply point. Each supply point in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this supply point.

kind.description: This field gives the type of the supply point, as one of the enumerated values.

name.description: This field gives the name of this supply point, for display.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the supply point, as latitude and longitude.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the supply point.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the supply point operates.

SupplyPoint.title: SupplyPoint

Sustainment.description: Sustainment is paragraph 4 of the order.

financial_management.description: This field gives the financial management plan.

health_service_support.description: This field gives the plan for health service support.

logistics.description: This field gives the logistics plan.

personnel.description: This field gives the personnel support plan.

priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of sustainment by unit or area.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the scheme of sustainment, as free text.

Sustainment.title: Sustainment

SustainmentAnnex.description: Annex for sustainment is the annex with the letter `F` in the order.

allocations.description: This list contains the supply allocations.

maintenance_priorities.description: This list contains the priorities of maintenance.

medical_evacuation.description: This field gives the medical evacuation plan.

medical_facilities.description: This list contains the medical treatment facilities.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex F, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex F, as free text.

supply_points.description: This list contains the supply points.

SustainmentAnnex.title: SustainmentAnnex

TargetingAppendix.description: Appendix for targets are `Appendix 3 (Targeting)` of Annex D.

high_payoff_targets.description: This list contains the attack guidance entries, in order.

target_reference_points.description: This list identifies the control measures that are target reference points.

time_sensitive_targets.description: This list contains the time-sensitive target (TST) entries.

TargetingAppendix.title: TargetingAppendix

Task.description: A task is one task to a unit, with its purpose, its time and the records that it refers to.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that do the task. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

id.description: This field identifies this task. Each task in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this task.

measures.description: This list identifies the control measures that the task refers to.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that the task is in.

purpose.description: This field gives the purpose of the task, as free text.

task.description: This field gives the task, as a verb with its object, as free text.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the unit does the task.

Task.title: Task

TaskOrganizationAnnex.description: An annex for task organization is the annex with the letter `A` in the order.

relationships.description: This list contains the command and support relationships.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about Annex A, as free text.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of Annex A, as free text.

TaskOrganizationAnnex.title: TaskOrganizationAnnex

Temperature.description: A temperature is a temperature with its unit.

unit.description: This field gives the unit of the temperature, `C` or `F`, as one of the enumerated values.

value.description: This field gives the value of the temperature, in the unit of `unit`.

Temperature.title: Temperature

Terrain.description: Terrain is the terrain data of the area of operations.

avenues_of_approach.description: This list contains the avenues of approach.

key_terrain.description: This list contains the areas and points of key terrain.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the effects of the terrain on the operation, as free text.

Terrain.title: Terrain

ThreatAssessment.description: A threat assessment is the assessment of one threat of the resource catalogue.

as_of.description: This field gives the time of the assessment.

capability.description: This field gives the capability of the threat, as free text.

confidence.description: This field gives the confidence level of the assessment, as one of the enumerated values.

emitters.description: This list identifies the emitters of the resource catalogue that the assessment refers to. Each emitter gives the position and the engagement ring.

enemy_unit.description: This field identifies the enemy unit of paragraph 1 that has the threat.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the threat at the time of the assessment, as latitude and longitude.

threat.description: This field identifies the threat of the resource catalogue that the assessment refers to.

ThreatAssessment.title: ThreatAssessment

TimeSensitiveTarget.description: A time-sensitive target is one time-sensitive target (TST) of the order.

ato_missions.description: This list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that can attack the target. The `orders` field identifies the ATO.

engagement_authority.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that gives approval for the engagement.

id.description: This field identifies this entry. Each entry in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this entry.

priority.description: This field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.

target.description: This field identifies the target of the resource catalogue that this time-sensitive target (TST) is for.

tst_number.description: This field gives the number of the time-sensitive target (TST), such as `TST-01`, as free text.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the target is possibly active.

TimeSensitiveTarget.title: TimeSensitiveTarget

TimelineEvent.description: A timeline event is one very important time or condition of the operation.

condition.description: This field gives the condition that starts the event, when the event has no fixed time, as free text.

event.description: This field gives the name of the event, as free text.

id.description: This field identifies this event. Each event in the timeline has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this event.

phase.description: This field identifies the phase of the operation that starts or stops at this event.

time.description: This field gives the time of the event.

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent

Unit.description: A unit is one unit of the task organization of the order.

agency.description: This field identifies the command and control agency that this unit operates.

callsign.description: This field gives the call sign of the unit, as free text.

commander.description: This field gives the name of the commander of the unit, as free text.

echelon.description: This field gives the echelon of the unit, as one of the enumerated values.

extensions.description: This field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group `sim` contains the simulator data of the record.

name.description: This field gives the name of this unit, for display.

parent.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the parent of this unit in the task organization.

position.description: This field gives the geographic position of the unit at the time of issue, as latitude and longitude.

remarks.description: This field gives the remarks about this unit, as free text.

unit_type.description: This field gives the type of the unit, such as `armoured infantry` or `F-16C squadron`, as free text.

Unit.title: Unit

UnitTasks.description: A tasks to a unit is the tasks to one subordinate unit.

tasks.description: This list contains the tasks to the unit.

unit.description: This field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the tasks.

UnitTasks.title: UnitTasks

WeaponsControl.description: A weapons control order is one weapons control status for an area and a time interval.

measure.description: This field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the weapons control status.

status.description: This field gives the weapons control status, as one of the enumerated values.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the weapons control status is in effect.

WeaponsControl.title: WeaponsControl

Weather.description: Weather is the weather data of the area of operations.

forecasts.description: This list contains the weather forecasts, in order.

light_data.description: This list contains the light data for each day, in order.

summary.description: This field gives the summary of the effects of the weather on the operation, as free text.

Weather.title: Weather

WeatherForecast.description: A weather forecast is the forecast weather for one time interval.

altimeter.description: This field gives the altimeter setting at the surface, which is the pressure reduced to mean sea level, as a pressure with its unit.

ceiling.description: This field gives the lowest cloud ceiling, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

clouds.description: This list contains the cloud layers, in order. The layers are in order from the lowest base.

effects.description: This field gives the effects of the weather on the operation, as free text.

precipitation.description: This field gives the type of precipitation, as one of the enumerated values.

temperature.description: This field gives the temperature at the surface, with its unit.

visibility.description: This field gives the horizontal visibility, as a length with its unit.

wind_direction.description: This field gives the direction from which the wind blows, as a bearing with its unit and reference.

wind_speed.description: This field gives the speed of the wind, as a speed with its unit.

window.description: This field gives the time interval during which the forecast is applicable.

winds_aloft.description: This list contains the winds at altitudes above the surface, in order.

WeatherForecast.title: WeatherForecast

WindAloft.description: A wind aloft is the wind at one altitude above the surface.

altitude.description: This field gives the altitude of the wind, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

direction.description: This field gives the direction from which the wind blows, as a bearing with its unit and reference.

speed.description: This field gives the speed of the wind, as a speed with its unit.

WindAloft.title: WindAloft

description: An operation order (OPORD) is a directive that coordinates the execution of an operation, in five paragraphs with annexes. The structure follows FM 5-0 and FM 6-0.

$schema.description: This field identifies the schema that validates this document.

acknowledgement.description: This field gives the acknowledgement instructions.

annexes.description: This field gives the annexes, by letter.

authentication.description: This field gives the signature block.

command_and_signal.description: This field gives paragraph 5 (Command and Signal).

date_time.description: This field gives the time of signature of the order.

effective_time.description: This field gives the time of the start of the effect of the order.

extensions.description: This field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group `sim` contains the simulator data of the record. The namespace `org.opord-builder.print` contains the data that `opord-builder` puts on each page.

issuing_headquarters.description: This field gives the name of the headquarters that publishes the order, as free text.

kind.description: The value identifies this record as an operation order (OPORD).

meta.description: This field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this document.

operation_name.description: This field gives the code name of the operation, as free text.

order_number.description: This field gives the number of the order, such as `26-01`, as free text.

orders.description: This field gives the air tasking order (ATO), airspace control order (ACO) and special instructions (SPINS) of the order.

period.description: This field gives the time interval during which the operation occurs.

references.description: This list contains the maps, charts and documents that the order refers to.

resources_ref.description: This field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this order.

schema_version.description: This field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this document agrees with.

task_organization.description: This map contains the units of the task organization. The key of each item is its identifier.

time_zone.description: This field gives the letter of the time zone that the order uses for display, such as `Z`. Each time in the document contains an offset.
